summary: On 26 October 2026, all six official XLSX workbooks were downloaded anew from the INEGI download catalog. All six SHA256 hashes exactly match the historical pinned binaries, and all 2,557 selected cell values agree with the bundled extract. Workbook titles, product row labels, reference year 2018 and metadata update 2023-08-29 also agree. This verifies the selected extraction, not every account in the complete matrices; the data remain a 2018 observation.

catalog_discovery.method: Read the two program pages, their public tab definitions and their download component; resolve each catalog pathLogico by prefixing https://www.inegi.org.mx/contenidos and appending .xlsx. Only the six selected workbook binaries were downloaded.

comparison_scope: Each of the 2,557 bundled cell values was read from its recorded workbook and coordinate and compared exactly with decimal arithmetic; full binary hashes were compared separately. Original extractor XML workbook reader was reused for cell inspection. The accounting row analysis and optimized-Python tests are recorded separately.

MIP_category.label: Elaboración de derivados y fermentos lácteos

classification_verification.scope: 311513 covers dairy derivatives and ferments, including cheese, cream, butter, yoghurt, casein, lactose, whey and imitation cheese. The broader 3115 also encompasses other dairy branches. These are classification definitions, not named-cheese or bilateral import categories.

limits: The downloaded full workbooks are not redistributed in this project; effective source URLs and binary hashes permit retrieval.
No update of the statistical reference year beyond 2018 is inferred from the 2026 verification date.
No complete-matrix audit, bilateral-country allocation, company identification or price/cost response estimation was performed.
locator_clarification: MIP_19 and MIP_38 select final/account cells through AFL196, whereas MIP_10 also selects AFM196 because AFL196 is its import-balancing entry. Historical locators in sources.json remain preserved; verified_locator gives the exact selected coordinates.
